title: Material places, processes and evidence paths
scope: Selected extraction, separation, metal/master-alloy, manufacturing and U.S. commercial/logistics locations. City/reference anchors are not surveyed facility coordinates; this is not a global census.
source_policy: Primary operator/government/issuer/research evidence; company-authored filing mirrors are explicitly labeled.
coordinate_policy: All markers are approximate. Published site coordinates, project maps, or named operating districts are cited per marker. Region, market and contract anchors must be visibly distinct from mine locations.
route_policy: Equal-width lines represent evidence-typed named relationships, never inferred tonnes, transport itineraries, fully qualified supply or shared-ownership shipments. Anonymous customers and unlocated processing gaps remain in text, not invented pins.
caveats: Mine ownership, operating entity, parent control and ultimate state control are separate concepts.
Resource material tags do not imply that every element is separated commercially at the mine.
General iron ore and borate routes are not proof of feedstock qualification for NdFeB magnets.
No mine-to-U.S. arrows are assigned to Bayan Obo, Maoniuping or the Jiangxi region: the cited import evidence resolves countries, not supplying mines.
Status reflects each source's evidence date. A 2026 access date does not convert an older status report into verified current output.
Contract and company display anchors are schematic; connecting curves are not vessel tracks, border-crossing records or physical shipping itineraries.
Unknown flows and missing arrows indicate an evidence gap, not proof of zero trade.
NdPr metal/oxide combines Nd and Pr; DyFe contributes Dy and Fe; ferroboron contributes Fe and B. Generic NdFeB only directly establishes Nd/Fe/B, not Pr/Dy/Tb in a delivered grade.
New city/place pins use rounded GeoNames references with per-record attribution (CC BY 4.0). Published industrial addresses remain in each card; pins are not precise premises surveys.
Co-located or group-level stages share an approximate anchor and have separate selectable entries. No artificial geographic offsets are used.
A U.S. commercial endpoint can be a distributor or contract counterpart, not a border-crossing port or delivered magnet customer.
2021 White Mesa–Silmet carbonate shipments are historical and do not establish 2026 Narva magnet provenance. Narva commercial delivery and Silmet small-scale HREE capability are separate facts.
